title: Process Creation Auditing is Not Configured
description: Auditing process creation events (Event ID 4688) is vital for recording program executions across the OS.
expected: Process Creation Audit = Success and Failure
impact: Malicious binary and script execution cannot be traced during forensics investigations.

title: Process Command-Line Auditing is Disabled
description: Including full process command lines in Event 4688 records CLI parameters passed to interpreters (PowerShell, cmd, mshta, certutil).
impact: Living-off-the-land attacks hiding payloads inside command-line flags remain invisible in security logs.
remediation_guidance: Enable command line in process events via GPO or Set-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System\Audit' -Name 'ProcessCreationIncludeCmdLine_Enabled' -Value 1

compliance_mappings.title: Include command line in process creation events

title: Logon and Logoff Auditing is Incomplete
description: Auditing both successful and failed logon attempts (Event 4624/4625) provides detection for unauthorized intrusions and brute force.
impact: Failed authentication attacks and unauthorized remote logons occur silently.
